title: Offline diarization result 1.0
description: Shape schema. DIARIZATION_RESULT_V1.md additionally specifies strict JSON lexical rules, trusted snapshot bindings, canonical order, reference/completeness invariants and exact-byte integrity; this schema alone is not an acceptance validator.

modelId.description: Safe ASCII model identifier; additionally reject '..' and reserved credential components/prefixes defined in the normative document. Preserve actual model identity; a version suffix is optional.

speakerLabels.description: Exactly SPEAKER_01 through SPEAKER_N in order, minimum two digits, no gaps or extra zero padding.

endMs.description: Integer token, at most 4300 digits; bounded by the independent trusted duration.

turns.description: Nondecreasing start times; 0 <= startMs < endMs <= independent trustedDurationMs. Preserve overlaps and all evidence. Every declared label must occur in at least one turn.

assignments.description: Exactly one per pinned segment, unique ordinals in snapshot order (not necessarily consecutive). Non-null labels must be declared.

diagnostics.description: Count must equal the number of null assignment labels. No provider text or operational errors.

count.description: Integer JSON token only, at most 4300 decimal digits; no booleans, strings, fractions or exponent notation.
